turnkey-vnm

## What to build

A tk-level flag before the subcommand makes the runner skip reads but still record fresh passes (runner mode `record-only`) (spec §1).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `tk --no-test-cache test <patterns>` executes every matched test
- [ ] Fresh passes are recorded, and a following plain `tk test` hits
- [ ] There is no env-var or config equivalent

- turnkey-vnm.7
title: `tk --no-test-cache test` forces a re-run
